latestTerminalSummary:
**The investigator stage is complete.** The single native Goal activated with the required objective, passed the binding guard, and was completed after all required outputs were saved. Its exact activation and completion responses are preserved in [native-goal-active.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P01-control/run/B10-P01-control/stages/investigator/native-goal-active.json) and [native-goal-terminal.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P01-control/run/B10-P01-control/stages/investigator/native-goal-terminal.json). Provenance and freshness are unknown beyond what the guard establishes.

The required [discovery](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P01-control/run/B10-P01-control/stages/investigator/discovery.md), [source map](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P01-control/run/B10-P01-control/stages/investigator/source-map.json), and [complete draft](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P01-control/run/B10-P01-control/stages/investigator/draft.md) are saved, along with the [source index](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P01-control/run/B10-P01-control/stages/investigator/sources/index.md) and [released plan](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B10-P01-control/run/B10-P01-control/stages/investigator/revealed-plan.md). The discovery hash matched the one-time reveal record.

The draft addresses every released-plan clause. It corrects the assumption that an HTTP 304 validates every passage selector: `If-None-Match` uses weak comparison, so that response alone does not prove byte identity or passage validity ([RFC 9110](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html)). Validation steps are proposals; no handbook, implementation, or tests were run.

The native Goal reports **432 seconds elapsed** and **202,230 tokens used**.
